Marissa / team -

Thanks for the context. Draft answers below - I'll expand into a one-pager before the workshop.

1) Recommended hardware (13B model, 200-500 TPS):
   - 4x A100-80GB (or equivalent) for primary inference fleet with model sharding; +1 spare node for N+1 fault tolerance.
   - NVMe cache: 4TB local NVMe per node recommended for KV/prefix cache to avoid network bottlenecks.
   - CPU: dual 24-core per node, 512 GB RAM for off-GPU preprocessing and batching.
   - Network: 25-100 Gbps leaf uplinks inside the cluster; no internet egress for inference VLAN.

2) Upgrade / rollback process (air-gapped):
   - Model/artifact staging: we provide signed tarballs with SHA256 and a detached signature.
   - Transfer: artifacts imported via encrypted, signed USB with chain-of-custody manifest.
   - Verification: offline checksum + signature verification script runs on an isolated verification host.
   - Deployment window: use Saturday 02:00-06:00 PT; model rollout staged across nodes with health checks and an automatic stop if error thresholds exceeded. Rollback involves re-deploying previous signed artifact from local cache; require ~30-45 minutes per node depending on model size.

3) Operational considerations:
   - KMS: recommend an HSM/KMS reachable only from a bastion host inside the isolated network; we support integrating with customer KMS devices via PKCS11 or offline key import.
   - Telemetry: for air-gapped installs we collect only local logs; we provide an exportable diagnostic bundle the customer can share with Redwood support via secure transfer.

I'll prepare the hardware checklist into the one-pager and include estimated procurement lead times and cost bands. Planning to have the deck ready by EOD tomorrow.

Rishi
